# mirror-leech-telegram-bot-fuse

> High-Performance Telegram Mirror, Leech & Linux FUSE Zero-Double-Storage Engine with Multi-Session TDLib Concurrency Pooling and Dual Cloud Backup.

mirror-leech-telegram-bot-fuse (`MHJoy99/mirror-leech-telegram-bot-fuse`) is an enterprise-grade asynchronous Python 3.12+ Telegram bot engine designed to eliminate the critical storage amplification bottleneck on storage-constrained Linux Virtual Private Servers (VPS). By mounting multi-gigabyte archives (`.zip`, `.tar`, `.7z`, `.rar`, `.iso`) directly into the Linux Virtual File System (VFS) via `archivemount` in `readonly,nosave` mode, raw file extents are streamed and decompressed on-the-fly directly to the splitting and upload pipelines without physical decompression to disk. This reduces peak disk space consumption by over 50%, capping peak storage usage to `Archive Size + Single Active Split (~2.4 GB)`.

## System Overview & Core Capabilities

- **FUSE Zero-Double-Storage Engine**: Mounts multi-GB compressed archives on-the-fly via Linux VFS (`archivemount -o readonly,nosave`), eliminating 2x physical disk extraction overhead.
- **Interactive Inline Telegram ZIP GUI Picker**: Native Telegram button interface (`/leech <link> -e -s`) featuring 8 items/page pagination, file selection checkboxes (`✅`/`⬜`), size calculations, and a 60-second AFK timeout fallback.
- **TDLib Multi-Session Concurrency Pool**: Bounded semaphore concurrency cluster rotating split and file uploads across multiple authenticated Telegram user accounts (`tdlib_user_*`) supporting up to 4 GB per file.
- **Dual Telegram Leech & Google Drive Backup**: Primary upload to Telegram chats with non-blocking asynchronous replication of final artifacts to Google Drive.
- **Leech vs Mirror Drive Leak Guard (`is_leech`)**: Strict destination isolation preventing `/leech` commands from leaking storage into Google Drive.
- **Small-File Pipeline & Anti-Choke Sequential Dispatch**: Automated `_picker_small_only` detection and sequential symlink upload dispatch preventing FUSE daemon lockups.
- **Smart WZML Media Captioning**: Real-time `ffprobe` metadata extraction for video resolution, duration, audio language codes (`langcodes`), and embedded/external subtitle streams.
- **Universal Multi-Engine Protocols**: Deep integration with `aria2c`, `qBittorrent` (with search plugins), `Sabnzbd` (Usenet / NZB), `JDownloader2`, and `yt-dlp`.

## Quickstart Guide

### Prerequisites
- Docker Engine 24.0+ & Docker Compose v2+
- Linux kernel supporting FUSE (`modprobe fuse`)
- Telegram Bot Token from `@BotFather` and API Credentials from `my.telegram.org`

### Installation

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/MHJoy99/mirror-leech-telegram-bot-fuse.git
cd mirror-leech-telegram-bot-fuse

# Configure environment
cp config_sample.py config.py
# Edit config.py with BOT_TOKEN, OWNER_ID, TELEGRAM_API, TELEGRAM_HASH

# Start Docker container with SYS_ADMIN and /dev/fuse
docker compose up -d --build
```

### Essential Commands
- `/leech <url> -e -s`: Download archive, mount via FUSE, launch Telegram inline ZIP picker, and leech selected files.
- `/mirror <url> -e`: Download archive, extract/mount, and mirror directly to configured cloud storage (Rclone / Google Drive).
- `/stats`: Display host and container hardware metrics (CPU, RAM, Disk partition, Network I/O, Subsystem versions).
- `/status`: Show real-time progress and speed of all active download and upload tasks.
